native_invalidation.stable_delete: Official App Server computes spawn subtree, prepares each member, deletes descendants before root; notifications follow successful result only. Not a target-only invalidation API.
native_invalidation.catalog: Desktop coordinator thread/deleted or thread/archived -> exact applyAuthoritativeRemoval, scan tombstone, sequence/revision, listener publish.
native_invalidation.renderer: deleted handler discards discovery, evicts cache, emits thread-list invalidation + thread-deleted.
native_invalidation.missing_entry: Private manager removeMissingEntry calls archived handler; local archive wrapper validates loaded/persisted/missing status. No reviewed public external invalidate-only contract established.
native_invalidation.global: No single native delete handler proved to clear every exact target main/bak/pin/renderer key.
native_invalidation.forbidden_shortcut: Do not fake native notifications as authority or switch to native cascade after local effect.
native_invalidation.dedicated_catalog_service: Internal appHost localThreadCatalog.notifyThread({hostId,threadId},remove) at bundle439 chars2836110 calls only catalog coordinator archived handler. It is narrower than general native thread/deleted, but external production transport/approval/collateral closure must still be reviewed and runtime-tested.

coordination.live: CLI writer locks and state SQLite exclusive fence do not fence Desktop whole-Map global state or independent catalog. Live direct mutation unsafe absent reviewed provider protocol.
coordination.stopped_candidate: Exact bundle/version/root/host+writer control; stop/restart are frozen approved effects; no generic process name kills; initially closed app not automatically launched outside designed policy.
coordination.profile_gap: Installed embedded CLI 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 differs stable exact 0.166.0 M8.2. Override resolver supports explicit stable candidate, but new composite profile must be tested.

structured_gui_probe.preload: window.electronBridge.getInitialSidebarBootstrap() returns main-process actual catalogEntries/catalogHostIds/globalStateEntries plus workspace state. Preload caches snapshot once per renderer; must recreate renderer to get fresh bootstrap.
structured_gui_probe.read_api: appHost exposes localThreadCatalog.readPage/readEntries/readStatus and thread services; private RPC requires exact bundled interface. No external generic port added to production.
structured_gui_probe.limits: Bootstrap is capped and samples top10 plus selected/pinned/project keys. Use small baseline fixtures and complete appHost paging; bootstrap alone is not all-surface proof.
structured_gui_probe.existing_service_binding: Exact app-shared export Vct is live services binding KQ, populated by Kwt. The real runtime and initializer both import it. Read existing Vct.localThreadCatalog to avoid registering a new app-host connection.

architectural_recommendations: Pure product assessment separate historical M8.2 PrimaryRemoved from CompleteSessionRemoval.
Domain owns categorical projection/reconstruction/coverage laws; adapter owns exact paths/schema/keys and admission.
Freeze required projection records, preimages, physical identities, host/root/app identity, shutdown/restart effects, retained baselines in existing immutable manifest and approval digest.
Unknown or visible projection risk prevents Removed and successful RemovedWithResiduals.
Every approved supported exact artifact attempted unless fresh safety revalidation fails; new discoveries replan.
No retry after uncertain effects, no generic SQL/JSON/cache ports, no whole shared-store restore.
Do not promote Desktop mutation until exact composite schema/coordination/real GUI restart and collateral acceptance pass.
